name: Moon
summary: Earth's only natural satellite, probably formed from a giant impact ~4.5 billion years ago; it stabilises Earth's tilt and drives tides.

name: Phobos
summary: A potato-shaped moon spiralling inward; it will break apart or crash into Mars in ~50 million years.

name: Deimos
summary: Mars's smaller, outer moon, smooth and dusty.

name: Io
summary: The most volcanically active body in the solar system, heated by tidal flexing.

name: Europa
summary: An ice-covered moon with a salty ocean beneath, a prime target in the search for life (Europa Clipper arrives 2030).

name: Ganymede
summary: The largest moon in the solar system, bigger than Mercury and with its own magnetic field; target of ESA's JUICE.

name: Callisto
summary: The most heavily cratered object in the solar system, possibly with a deep ocean.

name: Amalthea
summary: A small red inner moon that sheds dust into Jupiter's rings.

name: Himalia
summary: The largest of Jupiter's irregular outer moons.

name: Titan
summary: The only moon with a thick atmosphere and lakes of liquid methane and ethane; Huygens landed there in 2005.

name: Enceladus
summary: Sprays water geysers from a global subsurface ocean that contains salts, organics and phosphorus.

name: Mimas
summary: 'Death Star' moon with the giant Herschel crater; may hide a young ocean.

name: Iapetus
summary: Two-toned moon, one side dark as coal and the other bright as snow, with an equatorial ridge.

name: Rhea
summary: Saturn's second-largest moon, an icy, cratered world.

name: Dione
summary: Icy moon with bright ice cliffs.

name: Tethys
summary: Almost pure water ice, with the vast Odysseus crater.

name: Hyperion
summary: A sponge-like moon that tumbles chaotically.

name: Phoebe
summary: A captured Kuiper Belt object orbiting backwards.

name: Pan
summary: A 'ravioli'-shaped shepherd moon in the Encke Gap.

name: Miranda
summary: A patchwork moon with the tallest cliff known, Verona Rupes (~20 km).

name: Ariel
summary: The brightest Uranian moon, with young canyons.

name: Umbriel
summary: The darkest major moon of Uranus.

name: Titania
summary: Uranus's largest moon, discovered by William Herschel.

name: Oberon
summary: Outermost large moon of Uranus, heavily cratered.

name: Triton
summary: A captured Kuiper Belt object orbiting backwards, with nitrogen geysers seen by Voyager 2.

name: Nereid
summary: Has one of the most eccentric orbits of any moon.

name: Proteus
summary: A dark, box-shaped moon.

name: Charon
summary: Half Pluto's size, with a red north pole stained by gas escaping from Pluto.

name: Dysnomia
summary: Eris's moon, used to measure the dwarf planet's mass.

name: Dactyl
summary: The first moon of an asteroid ever found (by Galileo).

name: Dimorphos
summary: The moonlet NASA's DART spacecraft hit in 2022, shortening its orbit by 33 minutes, the first planetary-defence test.
